releaseNotes: Desktop app now reports its real version — the About screen and update checks were stuck on '1.0.0' before, so the updater could never tell when a new build was actually installed
Auto-update checks no longer fire concurrently when you switch or refocus the window — quieter logs, no wasted work, updates land more reliably

Release pipeline is live again — the GitHub Actions workflow is restored, so pushing a version tag builds the Windows installer and Android APK and publishes them with auto-update metadata in one step
Boot splash can no longer hang — public-settings and auth checks are bounded by timeouts, so the app always reaches the music within seconds even on a slow connection
Every page load is bounded by a 15s safety timeout — a stuck backend never leaves a spinner spinning forever; it resolves to a retryable error state instead
Music data keeps flowing even when Base44 integration credits are exhausted — all track, artist, and chart requests route through the independent Cloudflare Worker proxy, separate from the billing
Crash isolation at app, route, and section level — a single broken component never takes down the whole app, and a retry is always one click away
